description: Full record for one paper by bibcode, DOI or arXiv id — title, every author, journal, publication date, abstract, keywords and citation count. AUTHORITATIVE for the canonical bibliographic record of an astronomy paper, including the ADS bibcode that the citation and reference tools take. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH when you already know which paper you mean.

_apiKey.description: NASA ADS API token — free from https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/user/settings/token.

identifier.description: ADS bibcode (e.g. "2015ApJ...808...50A"), a DOI ("10.1088/0004-637X/808/1/50"), or an arXiv id ("arXiv:1505.02405" or "1505.02405"). The form is detected automatically.

name: ads_paper
title: Ads Paper
